title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional (SAP-C02)
summary: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional (SAP-C02) is a professional-level certification for practitioners who design and operate complex AWS estates. The exam is organised into 4 content domains: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity (26%), Design for New Solutions (29%), Continuous Improvement for Existing Solutions (25%), Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization (20%). It is delivered as 65 scored questions and 10 unscored, scored against a scaled pass mark of 750 out of 1,000 with no per-domain minimum, so strength in one domain offsets weakness in another. Every task statement in this topic carries a MEDIUM and a HARD exercise batch, so the practice material follows the published outline of the exam rather than a general reading list. The statements here are taken from the exam guide, and the task list is the one AWS publishes: if AWS revises the guide, this topic is revised with it.
objectives: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity: the guide's domain 1 focus, examined through its 5 task statement(s).
Design for New Solutions: the guide's domain 2 focus, examined through its 6 task statement(s).
Continuous Improvement for Existing Solutions: the guide's domain 3 focus, examined through its 5 task statement(s).
Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization: the guide's domain 4 focus, examined through its 4 task statement(s).
